reference_resolution.rule: version must resolve to an actual entry in CHANGELOG.md — no orphan references (issue-515 invariant 2).

recomputation.rule: change_type is recomputed from the actual diff category the release contains, never a standalone asserted field.
recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)

use_when.board_condition: a release is cut on the branch AND no release-engineering record exists yet for that version
